sources.title: auto-round 0.13.0 on PyPI - Libraries.io
sources.snippet: AutoRound is an advanced quantization toolkit designed for Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs). It achieves high accuracy at ultra-low bit widths (2-4 bits) with minimal tuning by leveraging sign-gradient descent and providing broad hardware compatibility.
